content: One of these M3x8rT screws was stripped in my case and my printer was factory assembled. I loosened the other 2 screws and then had a space on one side between the mount plate and bed stop. I took a bed scraper and used it as a wedge in the space to get the screw to catch some threads and I was finally able to turn it out.  I could see the obvious elongation and stripping on the screw. I would guess that whoever assembled it used a powered driver and wasn’t careful here. Thanks.

replies.content: The head was not stripped, the screw threads were.

content: Would recommend putting a cardboard box or other protector back on the build plate for this.

The center screw can preferably be removed first, had to use a lot of force on mine which caused the rod to twist. 

Solved it by putting on of the other screws back while removing the center screw.
